body:
Hello, friend!

My hut needs getting ready for winter, and my old labels have all faded away.

Will you come inside and write me some new ones?
summary: Write new labels for Mr. Silas's hut.

tasks.where: in Mr. Silas's hut on the mountain (walk the mountain road, or take the map)
at the coop by your house
in the grove behind the chapel
